notes.title: Regular update 0.1.2 is Here!
notes.content: [p]Regular update 0.1.2 [/p][p][/p][p]We've fixed and refined several key issues:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where the dialogue system overlapped with the shop menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected map reset: Shading of explored areas and savestones on the map now functions properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Mobs now have logic to back away from platform edges.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed damage colliders for the Ancient Imp.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated soul points getting stuck in wall colliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Volkolak transformation in the "Forge" and "Tsargrad" locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Access to the "Swamps" location is now only possible after completing a specific story event.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729047/c1b6d4498c3d1c5a8e49653a16c66e483aa6a919.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support—you're helping us improve![/p]

notes.title: Here is our first update! Version 0.1.1.
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Update 0.1.1.[/p][p]Based on player feedback, we made the following fixes:[/p][p][/p][p]1. Volkolak's animations are now smoother and more expressive. [/p][p]2. Markers are not reset when moving to new locations for more accurate navigation.[/p][p]3. A bug that caused Dark Volkolak to run out of the arena on wide monitors was fixed.[/p][p]4. The Warlock now reacts correctly to the player at the beginning of a boss fight.[/p][p]5. Locations for widescreen monitors have also been fixed for more comfortable passing.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your comments, they help us improve the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729047/abfaf16538b3f175908d92d2d119acdb9fbf52c1.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods Demo Update (0.2.3)
Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729047/9c348aa79d1239dada8e7b62d9c2c41e2ffed2fd.png[/img]
— Animation has become smoother. More than 250 new animations have been added, making the gameplay even more dynamic and lively. 

— We have completely redesigned the control system, providing an intuitive and user-friendly interface, and improved the intelligence of enemies, which adds deep strategy to the game battles. 

— Special attention has been paid to the introduction of a new resource — spirit energy, which will open new horizons for pumping equipment in future updates. And the activation of altars will affect the increase in health and stamina, which will subsequently give the opportunity to create a unique build for individual requests of players. For example, increasing the time of being in the guise of a Volkolak.

— New mechanics of amulets and consumables provide variety in tactical approach, and the quick access menu simplifies the management of inventory and active abilities.

— The mechanics of the ability menu have undergone changes, and the inventory has been redesigned to be more comfortable to use. 

— The visuals have been greatly improved, impressing with their beauty. 

— The game's map has also received a complete update, offering players new location shortcuts and the ability to quickly move between control points, which greatly speeds up exploration of the world. 

— In addition, we have added hints as well as quest markers to enhance the playability of the game.
